title: Material-level topological-exciton transport reproduction readiness audit

primary_source.citation: Thompson et al., Topologically enhanced exciton transport, Nature Communications 16, 11448 (2025)

supporting_source.citation: Jankowski et al., Excitonic topology and quantum geometry in organic semiconductors, Nature Communications 16, 4661 (2025)

published_control_logic.description: Swap SSH-like hopping order so topology changes while the two-hopping dispersion is algebraically invariant under t1<->t2.

available: published equations and aggregate 300 K diffusion values
polypentacene t1/t2 values from figure caption
DFT method family, cutoffs, k-point count and pseudopotential family
not_publicly_resolved_for_exact_transpor: plot numeric datasets stated by authors as available upon request
first-principles calculation input files stated by authors as available upon request
exact momentum-resolved exciton energies/group-velocity terms/scattering rates used to reconstruct the reported Eq. 7 totals
all material-specific transport-run numerical inputs needed for a from-scratch 300 K polyheptacene reproduction
explicit numerical acoustic/optical hopping-displacement coupling constants were not located in the public article text inspected; the paper ties realistic values to prior oligoacene work

claim_guards: Do not call the published 300 K diffusion ratios independently reproduced from aggregate-value arithmetic alone.
Do not transfer the ~3x/~4.5x narrative ratios to a project material.
The trivial comparator is a computational bond-reordered counterfactual, not evidence for a separately synthesized trivial material.
The source paper excludes defects/interfaces from the demonstrated bulk calculation; robustness to realistic disorder is a separate question.
Topological excitons can have stronger exciton-phonon scattering as well as larger geometric velocity; net transport enhancement is material-dependent.
next_gate: QG0c: reconstruct a material-specific free-exciton band/geometry result from public inputs; QG0d adds phonon-limited transport only after exact transport inputs are obtained or independently reconstructed.
